title: Proof-engine evaluation measurement row
description: One row per (lane, fixture, statement, variant) measurement. Rows are JSON Lines. scripts/eval/fixtures/summarize.py turns check.sh receipts (~/eval-receipts.jsonl) plus their logs and Replay output into rows of this shape, and reads lane-provided rows of this shape as they are. Times are milliseconds of the Lean profiler's cumulative categories for the whole file, measured with LEAN_NUM_THREADS=1 under check.sh; a file should hold one fixture so per-file times are per-statement (a file with a baseline and a new proof side by side shares elab/tactic/kernel profile times between both rows; its proof_stats, kernel_recheck and replay numbers stay per theorem).

family.description: Fixture family: Straight, Shared, Branch, Memory, LoopBody, or a lane's own.

variant.description: baseline (today's engine) or new (the lane's engine); free text after 'new:' allowed, e.g. new:vcgen.

statement.description: Fully qualified theorem name that was measured.

statement_hash.description: Replay.lean's Expr.hash of the theorem's type, mixed with the body of the definition the type names (a fixture's stmt). Equal hashes = same statement.

status.description: ok: exit 0; timeout: Lean ran longer than limit_s; oom: hit the -M cap (lean::memory_exception); error[:reason]: Lean error, e.g. error:simp-maxSteps.

wall_s.description: Wall time of the whole lean process (includes import and the Measure commands).

elab_ms.description: Front-end time: sum of profiler categories except import, initialization, interpretation, type checking, blocked (unaccounted), .olean serialization, compilation and linting.

tactic_ms.description: Profiler simp + dsimp + tactic execution + omega/grind/decide categories.

interp_ms.description: Profiler 'interpretation' (interpreted tactic code such as sc_bounds, and the #proof_stats walk).

kernel_ms.description: Profiler 'type checking' for the whole file.

kernel_recheck_ms.description: #kernel_recheck of the statement's theorem (main declaration only, in-file).

kernel_replay_ms.description: Replay.lean kernel-only time from the .olean: the theorem plus its auxiliary _proof_/_aux declarations.

heartbeats.description: Elaboration heartbeats (x1000) when the lane measured them (e.g. Mathlib #count_heartbeats in); null otherwise.

axioms_ok.description: Replay.lean: the theorem's axioms are within propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

commit.description: git HEAD of the repository (with +dirty when the tree had changes).

log.description: Path of the full lean output (~/eval-logs/...).

limit_s.description: Wall limit applied when status is timeout.

generated.description: true for rows measured on generated end-to-end artefacts (Contracts/VerifyCounter, Certified/verify_counter, Verify/VC...), false/absent for handwritten fixtures.
